Name: (RETIRED) Gem Dinosaur for Content Patcher
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
[size=3][b][u]INFORMATION[/u]: [i]This mod work in 1.6 if you change the Format to the current one in the content.json. It will not be updated further though. If you'd like a Gem Dino you can download the one I did for 1.6 that adds it's own animal![/i][/b][/size]

Thought it would be cute to have little dinosaurs who have some colorful gems growing from their back instead of spikes! Let's just imagine the dinosaurs have been in those caves for so long that the naturally spawning gems in there have started to use the dinosaurs as their growing habitat as well, hehe.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.
